query: SELECT dispatch_case AS "dispatch_case!", workspace_id AS "workspace_id!", task_id AS "task_id!", run_id AS "run_id!", step_id, attempt_id, logical_operation_id, task_created_at AS "task_created_at!" FROM ( SELECT 'queued' AS dispatch_case, task.workspace_id AS workspace_id, task.id AS task_id, run.id AS run_id, NULL::uuid AS step_id, NULL::uuid AS attempt_id, NULL::uuid AS logical_operation_id, task.created_at AS task_created_at, run.created_at AS run_created_at, run.reconciled_epoch AS run_reconciled_epoch FROM central.tasks task JOIN central.runs run ON run.workspace_id = task.workspace_id AND run.task_id = task.id AND run.id = task.current_run_id WHERE task.status = 'queued' AND run.status = 'queued' AND task.created_at >= $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM central.steps step WHERE step.workspace_id = run.workspace_id AND step.run_id = run.id) UNION ALL SELECT 'prepared_successor', task.workspace_id, task.id, run.id, attempt.step_id, attempt.id, attempt.logical_operation_id, task.created_at, run.created_at, run.reconciled_epoch FROM central.tasks task JOIN central.runs run ON run.workspace_id = task.workspace_id AND run.task_id = task.id AND run.id = task.current_run_id JOIN central.step_attempts attempt ON attempt.workspace_id = run.workspace_id AND attempt.run_id = run.id AND attempt.state = 'prepared' AND attempt.predecessor_id IS NOT NULL WHERE task.status = 'running' AND run.status = 'running' AND task.created_at >= $1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM central.execution_ownership ownership WHERE ownership.workspace_id = run.workspace_id AND ownership.run_id = run.id AND ownership.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()) ) dispatchable WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT epoch.epoch_generation, epoch.state FROM central.recovery_epochs epoch WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM central.recovery_epoch_workspaces scoped WHERE scoped.epoch_generation = epoch.epoch_generation AND scoped.workspace_id = dispatchable.workspace_id) ORDER BY epoch.epoch_generation DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest JOIN central.recovery_epoch_workspaces work ON work.epoch_generation = latest.epoch_generation AND work.workspace_id = dispatchable.workspace_id WHERE latest.state <> 'completed' AND work.delivery_state <> 'completed' AND dispatchable.run_reconciled_epoch < latest.epoch_generation AND (dispatchable.run_created_at < work.watermark_created_at OR (dispatchable.run_created_at = work.watermark_created_at AND dispatchable.run_id <= work.watermark_run_id)) ) ORDER BY task_created_at, run_id LIMIT $2
